original_ai_output.title_zh: 加纳东北贡贾地区洪灾致93栋房屋倒塌，246人无家可归
original_ai_output.summary_zh: 加纳萨凡纳地区东北贡贾县部分地区因暴雨引发严重洪灾，至少93栋房屋倒塌，超过246名居民失去住所。洪水还摧毁了粮食储备、农作物和牲畜，并损坏一条重要支线道路，导致Lantung Park、Kedingi和Kanankula等社区与外界隔绝。国家灾害管理组织（NADMO）表示此次洪灾由持续降雨引发。目前信息为单一来源报道。

location.raw_text: North East Gonja District of the Savannah Region

key_facts.fact: 加纳萨凡纳地区东北贡贾县暴雨引发严重洪灾，至少93栋房屋倒塌
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: Floods leave 246 without shelter as 93 houses collapse in North East Gonja

key_facts.fact: 超过246名居民因洪灾失去住所
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: At least 93 houses have collapsed and more than 246 residents have been left without shelter after torrential rains caused severe flooding in parts of the North East Gonja District of the Savannah Region.

key_facts.fact: 洪水摧毁粮食储备、农作物和牲畜，并损坏一条重要支线道路
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: The floods have also destroyed food stocks, farm produce, and livestock, while damaging a key feeder road and cutting off communities, including Lantung Park, Kedingi, and Kanankula, from surrounding areas.

key_facts.fact: 国家灾害管理组织（NADMO）称洪灾由持续降雨引发
